systemic_stress.evidence: OFR Financial Stress Index: a daily 33-variable global stress gauge with functional (credit / equity valuation / safe assets / funding / volatility) and regional (US / other-advanced / EM) decomposition. A coincident gauge — it names the stress CHANNEL when markets move as one; display + an optional risk-OFF gate, never cross-sectional alpha.

positioning.name: Options hedging mood期权对冲情绪
positioning.label: guarded警惕
positioning.verdict: more puts than calls — mild caution看跌多于看涨 — 轻度谨慎
positioning.tip: Put/call volume ratio on S&P index options, computed from CBOE's chain: bearish bets ÷ bullish bets traded today. Above ~1.3 = heavy hedging; below ~0.8 = complacency. Today: 1.03 (as of 2026-07-01). A young series — labels are based on standard thresholds until enough history accrues.标普指数期权的看跌/看涨成交量比，由 CBOE 期权链计算：今日看空押注 ÷ 看多押注。高于约1.3 = 大量对冲；低于约0.8 = 自满。今日：1.03（截至 2026-07-01）。这是一个较新的序列 — 在积累足够历史前，标签基于标准阈值。

positioning.tip: Estimated dealer gamma (GEX) from the S&P options chain, standard assumption (dealers long calls/short puts). Positive = their hedging dampens market moves; negative = it amplifies them. Today: +58bn per 1% move (as of 2026-07-01). An estimate, not ground truth.由标普期权链估算的做市商 gamma（GEX），采用标准假设（做市商持有多头看涨/空头看跌）。正值 = 其对冲抑制市场波动；负值 = 放大波动。今日：每1%波动 +58十亿 （截至 2026-07-01）。这是估算，并非真实值。

positioning.name: Fear gauge恐慌指标
positioning.label: leaning calm偏向平静
positioning.verdict: below normal, nothing extreme低于正常，但不极端
positioning.tip: VIX (30-day expected volatility) ÷ VIX3M (3-month). Below ~0.9 = calm; near/above 1.0 = the market fears the immediate future more than the distant one — the classic stress signature.
